entries.desc: The execution plan document exists and has purpose, non-goals, current inventory, target boundaries, execution rounds, verification matrix, and rollback/stop conditions.

evidence.note: Document exists at the declared path and includes purpose, non-goals, current inventory, compatibility contract, four implementation rounds, Authority flow, local quorum, verification matrix, implementation split, rollback/stop conditions, and reviewer checklist.

entries.desc: The document explicitly distinguishes B-0717 documentation work from future implementation stories so no source refactor is implied as done here.

evidence.note: The Purpose and Non-Goals sections explicitly state B-0717 is documentation only and does not refactor packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts or claim cli-engine decomposition is complete.

entries.desc: The plan does not hide high-risk process facts behind prose-only claims; gate/Authority-sensitive assertions point to mechanical verification or future required receipts.

evidence.note: Authority-sensitive claims require authority_receipt_verify against production gate_decision receipts and lifecycle receipt consumption; local status/readiness/verdict prose is explicitly barred from production Authority completion claims.

entries.desc: The plan includes a current inventory of cli-engine.ts responsibilities and explicitly notes that handlers are already split through registry/handlers.

evidence.command: wc -l packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts && rg -n "MAIN_TOOLS|parseFlags|ownerLeaseHelpBlock|resolveEffectiveOwnershipClass|enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate|commitInitCheckMetadataAndMergeMain|runCli|story_create|story_advance|recover_evidence" packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts && rg -n "from ./cli-engine|cli-engine" packages/main/src packages/main/tests scripts package.json packages/main/package.json
evidence.note: Source inventory confirms cli-engine.ts is 4450 lines, owns MAIN_TOOLS/flag helpers/owner and reviewer gates/init-check sync/runCli special dispatch, and handlers are already separated through registry/handlers consumers rather than requiring handler moves first.

entries.desc: The plan lists compatibility surfaces that future implementation stories must preserve or migrate, including MAIN_TOOLS, parseFlags, owner lease helpers, and init-check metadata sync exports.

evidence.note: Compatibility Contract section lists MAIN_TOOLS, parseFlags, parseFlagsTest, coerce, addValue, ownerLeaseHelpBlock, resolveEffectiveOwnershipClass, enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate, reviewer read-only helpers, and commitInitCheckMetadataAndMergeMain as preserve-or-migrate symbols.

entries.desc: The verification matrix uses commands that exist in the current package scripts or marks commands as conditional when no package script exists.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs && npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract && npm --prefix packages/main run test:main-write-lock-coverage && node packages/main/dist/tasks/cli-json-stdout-contract-smoke.js
evidence.note: All executable verification matrix commands completed successfully; JSON stdout smoke was run via direct dist task because no package script is declared for it.

entries.desc: The plan avoids a line-count-only split and instead assigns modules by responsibility boundaries with stop conditions for process-fact regressions.

evidence.note: Target Module Boundaries split by responsibility rather than line count and each round has stop conditions for command disappearance, schema drift, JSON stdout changes, owner/reviewer gate weakening, and INIT_CHECK metadata regression.

entries.desc: The plan defines the Authority Server command flow: status/readiness, job creation, independent verdict submission, job status reconciliation, receipt verification, and lifecycle receipt consumption boundary.

evidence.command: node bin/lattice.js authority_status --json; node bin/lattice.js authority_job_create --help; node bin/lattice.js authority_verdict_submit --help; node bin/lattice.js authority_job_status --help; node bin/lattice.js authority_receipt_verify --help
evidence.note: Authority command flow is mechanically available and documented: status/readiness, job creation, verdict submit, job status reconciliation, receipt verify, and lifecycle consumption boundary via verified production gate_decision receipt refs.

entries.desc: The plan defines 3 rounds x 2 hosts as required local strong-review quorum for high-risk cli-engine implementation slices.

evidence.note: Local 3x2 evidence was recorded: 6 pass verdicts across host A and host B, 2 independent passing hosts, staleVerdicts=0, multiHostVerified=true; every verdict note says local/offline and not a production Authority gate_decision receipt.

entries.desc: When authority_status is off/not-configured, the plan states that local 3x2 can proceed only as lower-assurance evidence and cannot claim production Authority DONE.

evidence.note: Current local Authority state is status=not-configured, authorityReady=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, canClaimProductionDone=false, so B-0717 cannot claim production Authority completion.

entries.desc: The plan states that 3 rounds x 1 host is a degraded fallback requiring explicit fallback classification, not a normal pass path for major architecture work.

evidence.note: Local Quorum Flow section defines 3 rounds x 2 independent hosts as default high-risk local review and 3 rounds x 1 host as degraded lower-assurance fallback only, never equivalent to 3x2 for major architecture work.
